# ONLYOFFICE Docs: Docs API

> Integrate and configure ONLYOFFICE Docs into your web app to enable document editing, co-authoring, and sharing for your users.

Links below point to the Markdown version of each page. For the other sections of this documentation, see the [index](https://ilyaoleshko.github.io/api.onlyoffice.com/llms.txt).

## Get started

- [Basic concepts](https://ilyaoleshko.github.io/api.onlyoffice.com/docs/docs-api/get-started/basic-concepts.md): ONLYOFFICE Docs is an open-source office suite that includes editors for documents, spreadsheets, presentations, PDFs, and fillable forms.
- [Installation - Cloud](https://ilyaoleshko.github.io/api.onlyoffice.com/docs/docs-api/get-started/installation/cloud.md): To install ONLYOFFICE Docs in the cloud:
- [Installation - Self-hosted](https://ilyaoleshko.github.io/api.onlyoffice.com/docs/docs-api/get-started/installation/self-hosted.md): ONLYOFFICE Docs is available for Windows, Linux and Docker.
- [Preloading static resources](https://ilyaoleshko.github.io/api.onlyoffice.com/docs/docs-api/get-started/configuration/preload.md): Starting from version 9.0, you can preload static assets (HTML, CSS, JS, fonts) into the browser cache before opening a document to speed up the first-time loading of the document editor.
- [Load balancing with shard key](https://ilyaoleshko.github.io/api.onlyoffice.com/docs/docs-api/get-started/configuration/shard-key.md): When ONLYOFFICE Docs runs as a multi-server cluster, collaborative editing requires that all requests for the same document reach the same server node. The shardkey query parameter enables this: your load balancer can read it from the URL and route accordingly.
- [Server configuration](https://ilyaoleshko.github.io/api.onlyoffice.com/docs/docs-api/get-started/configuration/server-config.md): Introduction
- [Try Docs](https://ilyaoleshko.github.io/api.onlyoffice.com/docs/docs-api/get-started/try-docs.md): Click the buttons with the format names below to try the main functionality of ONLYOFFICE Docs. You can open various file types for editing, viewing, co-editing, review or see how the rebranding works. Use the `` buttons to view the corresponding example source code.
- [How it works](https://ilyaoleshko.github.io/api.onlyoffice.com/docs/docs-api/get-started/how-it-works.md): For the end user, viewing, editing, and saving documents with ONLYOFFICE Docs is a simple process. For integrators, understanding what happens behind the scenes when a document is opened, saved, or uploaded helps when building and debugging an integration.
- [Opening file](https://ilyaoleshko.github.io/api.onlyoffice.com/docs/docs-api/get-started/how-it-works/opening-file.md): The figure and steps below explain how a document is opened in ONLYOFFICE Docs.
- [Saving file](https://ilyaoleshko.github.io/api.onlyoffice.com/docs/docs-api/get-started/how-it-works/saving-file.md): The figure and steps below explain how a document is saved in ONLYOFFICE Docs.
- [Co-editing](https://ilyaoleshko.github.io/api.onlyoffice.com/docs/docs-api/get-started/how-it-works/co-editing.md): The figure and steps below explain how a document is co-edited in ONLYOFFICE Docs.
- [Document history](https://ilyaoleshko.github.io/api.onlyoffice.com/docs/docs-api/get-started/how-it-works/document-history.md): The document editor can display a version history for documents, spreadsheets, presentations, and PDFs. The version data itself is stored by the document storage service — after each editing session, ONLYOFFICE Docs returns change information that the integrator saves alongside the document. The document editor then shows this history as a version list in a side panel, where the user can select any version to preview it.
- [Action link](https://ilyaoleshko.github.io/api.onlyoffice.com/docs/docs-api/get-started/how-it-works/action-link.md): The figure and steps below explain how a shareable link to a bookmark position in a document is created in ONLYOFFICE Docs.
- [Mentions](https://ilyaoleshko.github.io/api.onlyoffice.com/docs/docs-api/get-started/how-it-works/mentions.md): The figure and steps below explain how the mentions feature works in ONLYOFFICE Docs.
- [Renaming file](https://ilyaoleshko.github.io/api.onlyoffice.com/docs/docs-api/get-started/how-it-works/renaming-file.md): The figure and steps below explain how a document is renamed in ONLYOFFICE Docs.
- [Reviewing](https://ilyaoleshko.github.io/api.onlyoffice.com/docs/docs-api/get-started/how-it-works/reviewing.md): Review mode lets users suggest changes to a document without modifying the original text directly. All changes are tracked and can be accepted or rejected by users with the appropriate rights. This section explains how to enable and configure reviewing in your integration.
- [Inline editors](https://ilyaoleshko.github.io/api.onlyoffice.com/docs/docs-api/get-started/how-it-works/inline-editors.md): The steps below explain how to embed several ONLYOFFICE Docs editors on the same .html page.
- [Converting and downloading file](https://ilyaoleshko.github.io/api.onlyoffice.com/docs/docs-api/get-started/how-it-works/converting-and-downloading-file.md): The document conversion service is part of ONLYOFFICE Docs. It converts document files between supported formats — either to prepare them for editing or to export them in a format the user needs.
- [Security](https://ilyaoleshko.github.io/api.onlyoffice.com/docs/docs-api/get-started/how-it-works/security.md): ONLYOFFICE Docs uses token-based validation to ensure that requests between services have not been tampered with. Every request — whether it comes from the document editor initializing with a config, or passes between the document storage service and the document editing service, document command service, document conversion service, or document builder service — can carry a cryptographic token that the receiving side verifies before acting on the request.
- [Anonymous users](https://ilyaoleshko.github.io/api.onlyoffice.com/docs/docs-api/get-started/how-it-works/anonymous-users.md): The figure and steps below explain how an anonymous user’s name is set in ONLYOFFICE Docs.
- [Commenting](https://ilyaoleshko.github.io/api.onlyoffice.com/docs/docs-api/get-started/how-it-works/commenting.md): ONLYOFFICE Docs supports inline comments — users can leave comments on specific parts of a document, reply to them, and edit or delete them. All comments are persisted in the document and visible to other users who open it.
- [Comparing documents](https://ilyaoleshko.github.io/api.onlyoffice.com/docs/docs-api/get-started/how-it-works/comparing-documents.md): Document comparison highlights the differences between two documents as tracked changes — the user can then accept or reject each one.
- [Viewing](https://ilyaoleshko.github.io/api.onlyoffice.com/docs/docs-api/get-started/how-it-works/viewing.md): To open a document in view-only mode, set editorConfig.mode to "view". The user can read the document but cannot modify it.
- [Inserting external data](https://ilyaoleshko.github.io/api.onlyoffice.com/docs/docs-api/get-started/how-it-works/inserting-external-data.md): The figure and steps below explain how data from one spreadsheet is inserted into another via an external link in ONLYOFFICE Docs.
- [Mobile integration](https://ilyaoleshko.github.io/api.onlyoffice.com/docs/docs-api/get-started/how-it-works/mobile-integration.md): ONLYOFFICE Docs can run inside a native mobile application. The approach is to load the document editor in a WebView component (WebView on Android, WKWebView on iOS) — the same editor that runs in a desktop browser, but with the type parameter set to "mobile" so the UI is optimized for touch screens:
- [Mobile integration on Android devices](https://ilyaoleshko.github.io/api.onlyoffice.com/docs/docs-api/get-started/how-it-works/mobile-integration/mobile-integration-on-android-devices.md): The document editor can be embedded in an Android application using the WebView component. A complete demo project is available on GitHub.
- [Mobile integration on iOS devices](https://ilyaoleshko.github.io/api.onlyoffice.com/docs/docs-api/get-started/how-it-works/mobile-integration/mobile-integration-on-ios-devices.md): The document editor can be embedded in an iOS application using the WKWebView component. A complete demo project is available on GitHub.
- [Customizing themes](https://ilyaoleshko.github.io/api.onlyoffice.com/docs/docs-api/get-started/how-it-works/customizing-themes.md): You can create custom interface themes for ONLYOFFICE Docs by adding JSON configuration files to the themes directory on the server.
- [Embedding forms into a web page](https://ilyaoleshko.github.io/api.onlyoffice.com/docs/docs-api/get-started/how-it-works/embedding-forms-into-a-web-page.md): ONLYOFFICE Docs supports PDF forms — PDF files with fillable fields such as text inputs, checkboxes, and dropdowns. A PDF form has two usage modes:
- [Protecting ranges](https://ilyaoleshko.github.io/api.onlyoffice.com/docs/docs-api/get-started/how-it-works/protecting-ranges.md): The figure and steps below explain how range protection works in ONLYOFFICE Docs spreadsheets.
- [Setting avatars](https://ilyaoleshko.github.io/api.onlyoffice.com/docs/docs-api/get-started/how-it-works/setting-avatars.md): The figure and steps below explain how user avatars are set in ONLYOFFICE Docs.
- [Checking PDF forms](https://ilyaoleshko.github.io/api.onlyoffice.com/docs/docs-api/get-started/how-it-works/checking-pdf-forms.md): PDF forms differ from standard PDF files in form metadata. This metadata determines which editor opens a file: the form editor or the standard PDF editor.
- [Lifecycle of opening editor](https://ilyaoleshko.github.io/api.onlyoffice.com/docs/docs-api/get-started/how-it-works/lifecycle-of-opening-editor.md): The lifecycle of opening the editor is defined by a sequence of events that the API fires at each stage. Handling these events in your integration lets you respond to state changes — from initial load through document readiness to closing.
- [Playground](https://ilyaoleshko.github.io/api.onlyoffice.com/docs/docs-api/get-started/playground.md): The Playground serves as an interactive platform for users to explore and test the capabilities of the ONLYOFFICE Docs APIs without registration and installing anything. It provides users with various API functionalities, allowing them to experiment with different document types seamlessly.
- [Config Playground](https://ilyaoleshko.github.io/api.onlyoffice.com/docs/docs-api/get-started/config-playground.md): The Config Playground is an interactive tool for configuring ONLYOFFICE Docs API initialization parameters. Use it to visually build and test a configuration object and preview the result in a live embedded editor.
- [Frontend frameworks](https://ilyaoleshko.github.io/api.onlyoffice.com/docs/docs-api/get-started/frontend-frameworks.md): ONLYOFFICE Docs can be integrated with some of the existing frontend frameworks using components. These components provide ready-to-use code modules, standardized frontend technologies, and reusable interface blocks making the process of building user interfaces faster and easier.
- [React](https://ilyaoleshko.github.io/api.onlyoffice.com/docs/docs-api/get-started/frontend-frameworks/react.md): Integrate ONLYOFFICE Docs into a React application using the ONLYOFFICE Docs React component.
- [Angular](https://ilyaoleshko.github.io/api.onlyoffice.com/docs/docs-api/get-started/frontend-frameworks/angular.md): Integrate ONLYOFFICE Docs into an Angular application using the ONLYOFFICE Docs Angular component.
- [Vue](https://ilyaoleshko.github.io/api.onlyoffice.com/docs/docs-api/get-started/frontend-frameworks/vue.md): Integrate ONLYOFFICE Docs into a Vue.js application using the ONLYOFFICE Docs Vue.js component.
- [Ready-to-use connectors](https://ilyaoleshko.github.io/api.onlyoffice.com/docs/docs-api/get-started/ready-to-use-connectors.md): ONLYOFFICE Docs can be integrated into some of the existing document management systems using plugins. These plugins will add the document editing features into the document management system you use quickly and easily without having to write your own code.
- [Alfresco integration](https://ilyaoleshko.github.io/api.onlyoffice.com/docs/docs-api/get-started/ready-to-use-connectors/alfresco-integration.md): Integrate ONLYOFFICE Docs into Alfresco for document editing and collaboration.
- [Chamilo integration](https://ilyaoleshko.github.io/api.onlyoffice.com/docs/docs-api/get-started/ready-to-use-connectors/chamilo-integration.md): Integrate ONLYOFFICE Docs into Chamilo for document editing and collaboration.
- [Confluence integration](https://ilyaoleshko.github.io/api.onlyoffice.com/docs/docs-api/get-started/ready-to-use-connectors/confluence-integration.md): Integrate ONLYOFFICE Docs into Confluence for document editing and collaboration.
- [Drupal integration](https://ilyaoleshko.github.io/api.onlyoffice.com/docs/docs-api/get-started/ready-to-use-connectors/drupal-integration.md): Integrate ONLYOFFICE Docs into Drupal for document editing and collaboration.

- [Working with comments](https://ilyaoleshko.github.io/api.onlyoffice.com/docs/docs-api/samples/automation-api/working-with-comments.md): Manage document comments from an external UI via the Automation API.
- [Working with review changes](https://ilyaoleshko.github.io/api.onlyoffice.com/docs/docs-api/samples/automation-api/working-with-review-changes.md): Accept or reject tracked changes from an external UI via the Automation API.

- [Changing text in PDF](https://ilyaoleshko.github.io/api.onlyoffice.com/docs/docs-api/samples/automation-api/changing-text-in-pdf.md): Find and replace text in a PDF using the Automation API.

## API usage

- [DocEditor](https://ilyaoleshko.github.io/api.onlyoffice.com/docs/docs-api/usage-api/doceditor.md): DocsAPI.DocEditor is the main class of ONLYOFFICE Docs API. It is the entry point for creating, configuring, and managing a document editor embedded in a web page.
- [Configuration overview](https://ilyaoleshko.github.io/api.onlyoffice.com/docs/docs-api/usage-api/advanced-parameters.md): The configuration object passed to the DocsAPI.DocEditor constructor has the following main sections:
- [Config](https://ilyaoleshko.github.io/api.onlyoffice.com/docs/docs-api/usage-api/config.md): The config base section defines the top-level parameters for initializing the document editor.
- [Document](https://ilyaoleshko.github.io/api.onlyoffice.com/docs/docs-api/usage-api/config/document.md): The document section defines the document parameters.
- [Info](https://ilyaoleshko.github.io/api.onlyoffice.com/docs/docs-api/usage-api/config/document/info.md): The info section defines the document info parameters.
- [Permissions](https://ilyaoleshko.github.io/api.onlyoffice.com/docs/docs-api/usage-api/config/document/permissions.md): The permissions section defines the document permission parameters.
- [Editor](https://ilyaoleshko.github.io/api.onlyoffice.com/docs/docs-api/usage-api/config/editor.md): The editorConfig section defines the editor interface parameters.
- [Customization - Standard branding](https://ilyaoleshko.github.io/api.onlyoffice.com/docs/docs-api/usage-api/config/editor/customization/customization-standard-branding.md): The customization section defines the editor customization parameters.
- [Customization - White label](https://ilyaoleshko.github.io/api.onlyoffice.com/docs/docs-api/usage-api/config/editor/customization/customization-white-label.md): The customization section defines the editor customization parameters.
- [Embedded](https://ilyaoleshko.github.io/api.onlyoffice.com/docs/docs-api/usage-api/config/editor/embedded.md): The embedded section defines the embedded mode parameters.
- [Plugins](https://ilyaoleshko.github.io/api.onlyoffice.com/docs/docs-api/usage-api/config/editor/plugins.md): The plugins section defines the runtime plugin parameters.
- [Events](https://ilyaoleshko.github.io/api.onlyoffice.com/docs/docs-api/usage-api/config/events.md): The events section defines the callback functions for editor events.
- [Methods](https://ilyaoleshko.github.io/api.onlyoffice.com/docs/docs-api/usage-api/methods.md): After initializing DocEditor you will get the object that can be used to call the methods.
- [Automation API](https://ilyaoleshko.github.io/api.onlyoffice.com/docs/docs-api/usage-api/automation-api.md): Automation API enables interaction with office documents from external sources through custom interface elements. Build your own UI components while leveraging ONLYOFFICE document processing — manage comments, control review workflows, auto-fill forms, and more, all from outside the editor.
- [Connector class](https://ilyaoleshko.github.io/api.onlyoffice.com/docs/docs-api/usage-api/automation-api/connector-class.md): The Connector class allows editing documents, spreadsheets, presentations, PDFs, and fillable forms from an external source. It has the same interface as plugins.
- [Connector window](https://ilyaoleshko.github.io/api.onlyoffice.com/docs/docs-api/usage-api/automation-api/connector-window.md): The ConnectorWindow class is used to manage a modal window created by a connector inside the editor. To create it, use the createWindow method of the connector object.
- [Callback handler](https://ilyaoleshko.github.io/api.onlyoffice.com/docs/docs-api/usage-api/callback-handler.md): The document editing service informs the document storage service about the status of the document editing using the callbackUrl from JavaScript API. The document editing service uses the POST request with the information in body.

## Using WOPI

- [Overview](https://ilyaoleshko.github.io/api.onlyoffice.com/docs/docs-api/using-wopi/overview.md): Starting from version 6.4, ONLYOFFICE Docs offers support for the Web Application Open Platform Interface Protocol (WOPI) - a REST-based protocol that is used to integrate your application with an online office. WOPI operations allow you to open files stored on a server, edit and save them.
- [Config](https://ilyaoleshko.github.io/api.onlyoffice.com/docs/docs-api/using-wopi/config.md): For the WOPI protocol setup, it is necessary to edit the WOPI parameters in the configuration file, which can be found (or created) at the following path:
- [Key concepts](https://ilyaoleshko.github.io/api.onlyoffice.com/docs/docs-api/using-wopi/key-concepts.md): Learn the following concepts that are vital to understand the requirements for integrating with WOPI clients. For more information, see Microsoft key concepts.
- [WOPI discovery](https://ilyaoleshko.github.io/api.onlyoffice.com/docs/docs-api/using-wopi/wopi-discovery.md): WOPI discovery is a process which helps the WOPI server discover a WOPI client by requesting the discovery XML from an online office. WOPI hosts use the discovery XML to specify how to interact with the online office. The requests are sent to the https://documentserver/hosting/discovery address where the documentserver is the name of the server with the ONLYOFFICE Docs installed. You can register a free ONLYOFFICE Cloud and use its public IP address or public DNS that can be found in the Instances section of the cloud console.
- [Host page](https://ilyaoleshko.github.io/api.onlyoffice.com/docs/docs-api/using-wopi/host-page.md): In order to create an online office session within your application, a host must create an HTML page that will host an iframe element within it pointing to a particular WOPI action URL.
- [Proof keys](https://ilyaoleshko.github.io/api.onlyoffice.com/docs/docs-api/using-wopi/proof-keys.md): To restrict public access to your data, a secure exchange of requests between an online office and an integrator must be configured.
- [WOPI REST API](https://ilyaoleshko.github.io/api.onlyoffice.com/docs/docs-api/using-wopi/wopi-rest-api.md): WOPI REST API specifies a set of operations that enables a client to access and change files stored on a server.
- [CheckFileInfo](https://ilyaoleshko.github.io/api.onlyoffice.com/docs/docs-api/using-wopi/wopi-rest-api/checkfileinfo.md): GET /wopi/files/(file_id)
- [GetFile](https://ilyaoleshko.github.io/api.onlyoffice.com/docs/docs-api/using-wopi/wopi-rest-api/getfile.md): GET /wopi/files/(file_id)/contents
- [Lock](https://ilyaoleshko.github.io/api.onlyoffice.com/docs/docs-api/using-wopi/wopi-rest-api/lock.md): POST /wopi/files/(file_id)
- [PutFile](https://ilyaoleshko.github.io/api.onlyoffice.com/docs/docs-api/using-wopi/wopi-rest-api/putfile.md): POST /wopi/files/(file_id)/contents
- [PutRelativeFile](https://ilyaoleshko.github.io/api.onlyoffice.com/docs/docs-api/using-wopi/wopi-rest-api/putrelativefile.md): POST /wopi/files/(file_id)
- [RefreshLock](https://ilyaoleshko.github.io/api.onlyoffice.com/docs/docs-api/using-wopi/wopi-rest-api/refreshlock.md): POST /wopi/files/(file_id)
- [RenameFile](https://ilyaoleshko.github.io/api.onlyoffice.com/docs/docs-api/using-wopi/wopi-rest-api/renamefile.md): POST /wopi/files/(file_id)
- [Unlock](https://ilyaoleshko.github.io/api.onlyoffice.com/docs/docs-api/using-wopi/wopi-rest-api/unlock.md): POST /wopi/files/(file_id)
- [PostMessage](https://ilyaoleshko.github.io/api.onlyoffice.com/docs/docs-api/using-wopi/postmessage.md): PostMessage is the HTML5 Web Messaging protocol which allows exchanging messages in the browser between the iframe storage and ONLYOFFICE Docs. It allows the online office frame to communicate with its parent host page.
- [Conversion API](https://ilyaoleshko.github.io/api.onlyoffice.com/docs/docs-api/using-wopi/conversion-api.md): In order to convert different file formats in the online office, the POST request should be used. These requests are sent to the /cool/convert-to/\&\ or /lool/convert-to/\&\ endpoints.
- [Editing binary documents](https://ilyaoleshko.github.io/api.onlyoffice.com/docs/docs-api/using-wopi/editing-binary-documents.md): The online office does not support editing files in the legacy binary formats such as doc, ppt, and xls. However, it can convert documents in such formats to the docx, pptx, and xlsx formats accordingly to let the users edit their contents in the online office.
- [API vs WOPI](https://ilyaoleshko.github.io/api.onlyoffice.com/docs/docs-api/using-wopi/api-vs-wopi.md): You can integrate ONLYOFFICE Docs with any cloud service using either API or WOPI.

## Additional API

- [Command service](https://ilyaoleshko.github.io/api.onlyoffice.com/docs/docs-api/additional-api/command-service.md): For the interaction with the document command service the POST requests are used. The request parameters are entered in JSON format in the request body. The requests are sent to the https://documentserver/command address where the documentserver is the name of the server with the ONLYOFFICE Docs installed.
- [deleteForgotten](https://ilyaoleshko.github.io/api.onlyoffice.com/docs/docs-api/additional-api/command-service/deleteforgotten.md): Deletes a forgotten file.
- [drop](https://ilyaoleshko.github.io/api.onlyoffice.com/docs/docs-api/additional-api/command-service/drop.md): Disconnects the users with the identifiers specified in the users parameter from the document editing service. These users will be able to view the document, but will not be allowed to make changes to it.
- [forcesave](https://ilyaoleshko.github.io/api.onlyoffice.com/docs/docs-api/additional-api/command-service/forcesave.md): Forcibly saves the document being edited without closing it. The document editing might be continued after this command, so this will not be the final saved document version.
- [getForgotten](https://ilyaoleshko.github.io/api.onlyoffice.com/docs/docs-api/additional-api/command-service/getforgotten.md): Requests a forgotten file.
- [getForgottenList](https://ilyaoleshko.github.io/api.onlyoffice.com/docs/docs-api/additional-api/command-service/getforgottenlist.md): Requests a list of the forgotten files.
- [info](https://ilyaoleshko.github.io/api.onlyoffice.com/docs/docs-api/additional-api/command-service/info.md): Requests a document status and the list of the identifiers of the users who opened the document for editing. The response will be sent to the callback handler.
- [license](https://ilyaoleshko.github.io/api.onlyoffice.com/docs/docs-api/additional-api/command-service/license.md): Requests the license from ONLYOFFICE Docs with information about the server and user quota.
- [meta](https://ilyaoleshko.github.io/api.onlyoffice.com/docs/docs-api/additional-api/command-service/meta.md): Updates the meta information of the document for all collaborative editors.
- [version](https://ilyaoleshko.github.io/api.onlyoffice.com/docs/docs-api/additional-api/command-service/version.md): Requests the current version number of ONLYOFFICE Docs.
- [Conversion API](https://ilyaoleshko.github.io/api.onlyoffice.com/docs/docs-api/additional-api/conversion-api.md): The Conversion API documentation provides comprehensive details on how to handle document conversion tasks. Explore the following pages to understand the request and response structures, error codes, and supported conversion formats.
- [Request](https://ilyaoleshko.github.io/api.onlyoffice.com/docs/docs-api/additional-api/conversion-api/request.md): For the interaction with the document conversion service the POST requests are used. The request parameters are entered in JSON format in the request body. The requests are sent to the https://documentserver/converter address where documentserver is the name of the server with the ONLYOFFICE Docs installed.
- [Response](https://ilyaoleshko.github.io/api.onlyoffice.com/docs/docs-api/additional-api/conversion-api/response.md): The request result is returned in XML format. To receive a response in JSON format you need to specify the Accept header with the application/json value in the HTTP request. When forming the link to the resulting file, the same server name is used to which the conversion request was made.
- [Conversion tables](https://ilyaoleshko.github.io/api.onlyoffice.com/docs/docs-api/additional-api/conversion-api/conversion-tables.md): Below you can find tables with formats that are available for conversion in different types of editors.
- [Error codes](https://ilyaoleshko.github.io/api.onlyoffice.com/docs/docs-api/additional-api/conversion-api/error-codes.md): An error can occur during the conversion. Below you can find possible error codes and their description.
- [Document Builder API](https://ilyaoleshko.github.io/api.onlyoffice.com/docs/docs-api/additional-api/document-builder-api.md): For the interaction with the web document builder service the POST requests are used. The request parameters are entered in JSON format in the request body. The requests are sent to the https://documentserver/docbuilder address where documentserver is the name of the server with the ONLYOFFICE Docs installed.
- [Signature](https://ilyaoleshko.github.io/api.onlyoffice.com/docs/docs-api/additional-api/signature.md): ONLYOFFICE Docs uses tokens generated using the JSON Web Tokens standard. The tokens are sent when performing the client-side browser requests to ONLYOFFICE Docs or the HTTP requests to or from ONLYOFFICE Docs.
- [Browser](https://ilyaoleshko.github.io/api.onlyoffice.com/docs/docs-api/additional-api/signature/browser.md): When performing the client-side browser requests to ONLYOFFICE Docs, a token must be added to the parameters to validate the data.
- [Request](https://ilyaoleshko.github.io/api.onlyoffice.com/docs/docs-api/additional-api/signature/request.md): When performing the HTTP requests from or to ONLYOFFICE Docs, the token is added to the parameters to validate the data. The token can be sent:
- [Token in body](https://ilyaoleshko.github.io/api.onlyoffice.com/docs/docs-api/additional-api/signature/request/token-in-body.md): Starting from version 5.2, it is possible to use the token in body parameters with ONLYOFFICE Docs. To enable it, set the services.CoAuthoring.token.inbox.inBody and services.CoAuthoring.token.outbox.inBody in configuration file to true.
- [Token in header](https://ilyaoleshko.github.io/api.onlyoffice.com/docs/docs-api/additional-api/signature/request/token-in-header.md): When performing the HTTP requests from or to ONLYOFFICE Docs an authorization header with the token is added to validate the request.
